rationale: design-import-refactor: generic change landed in Pulp per owner decision 2026-10-04; Vellum inherits (see inheritance ledger); canvas-kernel: the font resolver, the SkParagraph collection's default font manager and bundled-family matching now pick a family's weight by the CSS Fonts 4 order (one shared css_match_font_weight helper) instead of the platform's nearest weight, so imported text paints the face the capturing browser drew and resolved_face_identity() agrees with the paragraph face. Fixes Helvetica Neue 600 painting Medium. No API or authority boundary moves. Vellum inherits the weight-matching rule with the canvas kernel.
